items.title: A pinned release
items.blurb: asbuilt = "X.Y.Z" in asbuilt.toml, and any other release stops with the install line instead of showing its output as drift.

items.title: Drop-in CI
items.blurb: A GitHub Action that installs the release asbuilt.toml pins and notes a newer one, cargo-binstall metadata, and aarch64 Linux and musl builds.

items.title: Drift you can read
items.blurb: check names what changed (a relation added, a module removed) and speaks JSON with --format json.

items.title: Relation kinds you can see
items.blurb: A line and arrowhead per kind, so implements and uses differ at a glance, and a legend.

items.title: Architecture diff between revisions
items.blurb: asbuilt diff main..HEAD names how the architecture changed between two commits (modules added, relations moved), and the action can post it on a pull request.

items.title: Architecture rules
items.blurb: Rules you declare (no cycles, which layers may depend on which), checked like drift and reported the same way.

items.title: Edges that list only what they draw
items.blurb: An edge's popover lists the relations that edge draws, not every relation between its endpoints, so a filtered view stays filtered.

items.title: A second language: Python
items.blurb: A Python front-end, dogfooded on a FastAPI code base: packages to containers, modules to components, imports to relations, and the docs pages in Python's own words.

items.title: Installing without cargo
items.blurb: An install script that checks the release's attestation, and a Homebrew tap, for teams without a Rust toolchain.

items.title: Coupling metrics
items.blurb: Coupling metrics per crate and module on their pages.

items.title: Dependencies as externals
items.blurb: Opt-in externals from Cargo.toml, and crate-to-crate summaries on each container page.

items.title: Features and cfg
items.blurb: Know which modules and relations a feature or platform turns on.

items.title: LikeC4's interactive viewer
items.blurb: An option to embed LikeC4's own web component: element details, a relationship browser, search.

items.title: A deployment front-end
items.blurb: Infrastructure as the model's deployment section, which is empty today.

items.title: Relation styles in [theme]
items.blurb: Choose each relation kind's line and arrowhead, as [theme] chooses each element kind's color.

items.title: A legend in rendered SVGs
items.blurb: The legend inside the SVG files asbuilt render writes, for diagrams embedded outside the docs.
